## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue
or roadmap item. Include migration notes for public API changes.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant behavior, cancellation and failure paths checked.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, or documentation-only link/diff checks are recorded.
- [ ] Public behavior and known limits documented.
- [ ] Browser interaction or performance evidence included when applicable.
- [ ] Hosted `Check (Node 22)` and `Check (Node 24)` pass on the current PR commit.

## Risks and limits

Record remaining compatibility, performance or rollout limitations. Release
preparation does not publish to npm; follow `docs/releases.md` for publication.
